prompts.title: Executive Studio Portrait
prompts.prompt:
IDENTITY REFERENCE

Use the uploaded photo only as a face and identity reference. Preserve the subject’s recognizable identity with high fidelity: natural facial structure, skin tone, eye shape and color, nose, lips, jawline, eyebrows, ears, facial proportions, and other distinctive characteristics.

Identity takes priority over styling. Do not beautify, reshape, slim, widen, sharpen, soften, age, de-age, or reinterpret the face. Preserve natural facial asymmetry and the relative size, spacing, and placement of facial features.

If the reference shows facial hair, preserve its approximate density and grooming style; if clean-shaven, keep the subject clean-shaven. Preserve subtle identity-defining details visible in the reference. Do not invent glasses, jewelry, facial hair, tattoos, or accessories.

Do not copy the original pose, clothing, lighting, framing, or background.

SCENE

Create an ultra-realistic luxury studio executive portrait, photographed straight-on and centered. The subject should appear composed, confident, and natural, with a relaxed executive posture rather than a stiff or overly formal pose. Keep the body generally facing the camera and the face looking directly toward the lens, but allow subtle natural asymmetry in the shoulders, neck, and facial posture so the result feels human and effortless. Maintain direct eye contact and a calm, serious, confident neutral expression, with relaxed lips and no exaggerated posing.

WARDROBE

Dress the subject in a tailored cool dark charcoal-gray three-piece suit with a subtle fine woven texture, matching waistcoat, crisp white dress shirt, and a deep navy-black textured necktie.

The suit should have realistic lapels, seams, buttons, folds, stitching, and natural fabric weight. No visible logos or distracting accessories.

HAIR

Keep the hairstyle believable for the subject, with realistic density, natural hairline, individually resolved strands, subtle flyaways, and natural highlights.

BACKGROUND

Use a dark charcoal-black studio background with a subtle cool blue-teal undertone. Create a soft smoky gradient that is slightly brighter behind the head and upper shoulders and gradually falls into near-black toward the outer edges, producing gentle subject separation.

Keep the background smooth, minimal, softly out of focus, and free of scenery, objects, patterns, text, or visible studio equipment.

LIGHTING

Use refined three-point studio lighting: a large soft key light slightly above and in front of the face, gentle frontal fill to retain facial detail, and subtle rim light along the hair, ears, jawline, and shoulders.

The face should be clearly illuminated with controlled highlights on the forehead, nose, cheekbones, and lips, while retaining rich dimensional shadows. Keep the suit dark but visibly detailed, never crushed into black.

SKIN AND FACIAL DETAIL

Preserve true human skin micro-texture with natural pores and tonal variation. No plastic skin, beauty-filter smoothing, waxy texture, excessive sharpening, artificial HDR, or CGI appearance.

Both eyes must remain sharply and independently resolved with natural irises, pupils, sclera, catchlights, eyelids, tear lines, and lashes. Preserve eyebrow hairs, beard or stubble strands where applicable, lips, nostrils, ear contours, hairline, and fine facial texture.

Facial features must remain stable and anatomically coherent under close inspection, with no identity drift, altered facial proportions, mismatched eyes, warped ears, melted details, or duplicated features.

FRAMING AND COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 upper-torso portrait.

Frame the subject from approximately the lower chest upward, showing the full head, neck, tie, waistcoat, lapels, and both shoulders.

Keep approximately 8–10% comfortable negative space above the hair. Both shoulders should remain fully visible.

The subject must be exactly centered, with natural head-to-body proportions and no oversized head. Do not crop the hair, chin, shoulders, or tie awkwardly.

CAMERA

Professional full-frame camera look with an 85mm portrait lens at approximately f/4–f/5.6, eye-level camera position, tack-sharp focus on both eyes and facial features, realistic optical rendering, smooth tonal falloff, rich blacks, controlled contrast, natural dynamic range, and restrained cinematic color grading.

The final image should look like a genuine high-end executive studio photograph: photorealistic, sophisticated, powerful, minimal, timeless, and polished without appearing artificially retouched.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No smile unless naturally present in the reference, no strong head tilt, no dramatic three-quarter pose, no side profile, no crossed arms, no visible hands, no casual clothing, no colorful suit, no patterned tie, no busy background, no text, no logos, no invented eyewear or facial hair, no beauty filter, no waxy skin, no distorted face, no altered identity, no blurry facial details, no oversized head, no CGI or rendered appearance.

prompts.title: Sophisticated Gentleman Look
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic 4:5 vertical editorial portrait of the uploaded male subject, preserving his natural facial identity, facial proportions, age, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, eye shape, and facial hair exactly as shown in the reference. Do not beautify, reshape, age, de-age, or add/remove facial hair.
Frame him in a centered waist-up composition, standing upright and facing the camera with squared, level shoulders. His arms are folded firmly but naturally across his torso: one forearm forms a clean horizontal line across the body with the wristwatch clearly visible on the viewer’s left, while the opposite hand rests naturally on the upper arm. Keep both elbows and the complete folded-arm pose inside the frame. His head remains straight with a neutral chin position, direct eye contact, relaxed closed lips, and a calm, serious, self-assured expression conveying quiet authority and refined executive confidence.
Dress him in a perfectly tailored charcoal-grey blazer featuring a subtle micro-check or Prince-of-Wales pattern, structured shoulders, broad notched lapels, a single-breasted two-button front, and detailed four-button sleeve cuffs. Underneath, he wears a fitted medium-grey ribbed turtleneck with a neatly folded high collar. Add a crisp white pocket square arranged elegantly in the breast pocket and narrow white shirt cuffs subtly visible beneath the blazer sleeves. Complete the styling with a sophisticated classic wristwatch featuring a polished gold case, minimal white dial, and dark brown leather strap. The tailoring should look realistic, with accurate fabric texture, natural folds, clean seams, and a premium fitted silhouette.
Place him in front of an elegant modern building entrance or upscale architectural interior. Keep the background heavily blurred, featuring dark charcoal and black structural surfaces, a soft neutral-grey column on the left, and several warm amber circular lights creating creamy bokeh on the right. The environment should feel luxurious and understated without recognizable objects, text, or logos.
Use soft directional light from slightly above and in front of the subject, gently defining the cheekbones, jawline, eyes, and fabric texture without harsh shadows. Add subtle frontal fill for balanced facial exposure and delicate separation from the dark background. Maintain realistic skin pores, natural complexion variation, individual hair strands, detailed eyes, and authentic fabric texture without excessive smoothing or artificial sharpening.
Capture at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens at approximately f/1.8–f/2.2, producing natural facial proportions, sharp focus on the face and clothing, and a smooth shallow depth of field. Apply a sophisticated cinematic colour grade dominated by charcoal and neutral grey tones, restrained warm amber highlights, slightly warm natural skin tones, rich blacks, and polished editorial contrast. High-end luxury menswear campaign, executive portrait photography, photorealistic, refined, timeless and professionally retouched while remaining completely natural.
Avoid a tight crop, casual smile, exaggerated muscles, distorted arms or fingers, uneven shoulders, warped lapels, incorrect watch placement, plastic skin, excessive HDR, distracting background details, text, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.title: Pinstripe Confidence
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic black-and-white fashion editorial portrait with a cinematic luxury studio aesthetic: elegant, minimal, refined, powerful, and magazine-quality.

Composition:
Medium-shot vertical 4:5 portrait. The subject is slightly off-center, leaning confidently against a modern backward-facing wooden studio chair. The upper body, chair, both hands, wristwatch, and part of the lower body must be visible. Keep clean editorial framing, strong negative space, and no awkward cropping.

Pose:
The subject is not seated. They lean naturally against the chair in a relaxed but powerful posture. One arm rests over the top edge of the chair back, while the other hand stays naturally inside the trouser pocket. The wristwatch must be clearly visible. Shoulders relaxed, posture composed, body language strong, self-assured, and editorial.

Expression & Gaze:
Calm, confident, self-assured expression with closed lips or a subtle neutral look. The subject must not look sad, tired, weak, shy, dull, or emotionally heavy. Gaze slightly off-camera to the side, not directly into the lens.

Wardrobe:
Perfectly tailored slim-fit dark pinstripe suit with subtle vertical stripes, paired with a dark open-collar shirt. In black-and-white, the suit and shirt must have clear tonal separation: suit slightly lighter or more textured, shirt slightly deeper or smoother. The outfit should look sharp, structured, premium, fitted, with crisp tailoring lines and realistic fabric texture.

Hair & Styling:
Preserve the subject’s hairstyle and natural texture accurately. Styling should feel polished, elegant, and fashion-editorial. Keep makeup or grooming minimal and refined, enhancing the face without looking artificial.

Environment:
Minimal seamless dark grey gradient studio backdrop. No visible edges, corners, extra props, text, logos, or distractions except the wooden chair.

Lighting:
Moody directional studio lighting in pure monochrome. Use strong but controlled contrast with soft falloff to sculpt the face, cheekbones, jawline, hair, suit texture, shirt separation, wristwatch, hands, and chair details. Maintain cinematic depth, rich tonal range, and no harsh overexposure.

Quality & Style:
Ultra-realistic 8K monochrome fashion editorial photography. Crisp focus on the face, eyes, lips, hair, suit fabric, shirt, watch, hands, and chair. Realistic skin texture, natural shadows, refined tonal depth, and premium magazine finish. No plastic skin, no artificial smoothing, no painterly effect, no warm tone, no sepia tint.

Negative Instructions:
Do not make the subject seated, slouched, sad, weak, shy, overly emotional, lifeless, or directly looking into the camera. Do not blend the shirt and suit into one flat tone. Do not crop the hands, wristwatch, head, or chair. Do not add extra props, text, logos, warm tones, sepia tint, or distracting background elements.
